comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal from a connector housing; record selects fitting tweezers and peels protective film from a display module.
comparison.physical_skill: Single-blade insertion under a recessed locking tab with wire-tool co-pull versus tool selection, tab grasping, carrier bracing, progressive adhesive peeling, and tool return.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires one intended terminal out without damage or neighbor release; numeric force/damage thresholds are missing. Record requires full 115 mm peel, bounded carrier motion and seam separation, film placement, both tweezers returned, and hands away.
comparison.reason: Small-slot tool access and bimanual bracing are shared, but adhesive peel mechanics and tool selection do not test connector-latch depinning.
